zh: 迁入本地加载优化：对话分页与可恢复侧栏范围、按页面刷新、首页可见时统计、正文搜索按需索引、异步目录扫描与缓存；手机模块仅在窄屏或触屏加载。
en: Local loading changes add bounded conversation pages, reversible sidebar ranges, page-specific refreshes, visible dashboard polling, demand-driven text indexing, asynchronous log discovery and caches. Phone code loads only on narrow or touch screens.
